usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank, euro reference exchange rate (USD)
usdRate.note: Bulgaria replaced the lev (BGN) with the euro on 1 January 2026 at BGN 1.95583 per euro (CLDR still lists BGN). USD 1.1172 per EUR, so EUR 0.8951 per US dollar.

inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 5.7% in September 2026 (5.1% in August); HICP 5.6% (Eurostat). Secondary source for the NSI release.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% target (Bulgaria in the euro area since January 2026); HICP 5.6% (Sep 2026), 12-month average 4.2%
inflation_projection.note: The ECB target anchors the long run, but price-level catch-up with richer euro members keeps Bulgarian inflation higher, so 3% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, deposit facility rate
policy_rate.note: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026, so ECB rates apply: deposit facility 2.50%, main refinancing 2.65%, held on 29 October 2026 (read via the ECB data API).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Bulgarian bank rates on household deposits redeemable at notice up to 3 months (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: 0.43% in September 2026 (0.41% in August); overnight (current) deposits pay about 0.01%. Read via the ECB data API.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Bulgarian bank rates on household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_3m_rate.note: No separate 3-month series is published; the up-to-1-year bucket (1.49% in September 2026, 1.40% in August) is used. Read via the ECB data API.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Bulgarian bank rates on household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: 1.49% in September 2026 (1.40% in August); 1-2 years 1.60%, over 2 years 2.86%. Read via the ECB data API.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for a monthly recurring deposit product at Bulgarian banks was found; the ECB MIR statistics do not separate such products.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 0.25% in 2025, weighted towards current accounts; ECB MIR new-business term deposits up to 1 year paid 1.49% in September 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings bond for individuals with a current rate was found; the Ministry of Finance site refused automated access.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 3-month Bulgarian treasury bill yield was found; government securities auctions are mainly for bonds and the Ministry of Finance site refused automated access.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No Bulgarian 5-year government bond yield was found on readable pages (Trading Economics shows only a stale 10-year quote).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, Bulgaria (10-year government bond)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average for September 2026, read via the ECB data API; Trading Economics' Bulgarian quote was stale (February 2025).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Bulgaria income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on bank accounts in the EU/EEA is tax-free since 1 April 2022; accounts outside the EU/EEA are taxed at 10%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Bulgaria income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest and discounts on bonds are exempt income for individuals (subject to conditions in the law).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank; up to EUR 125,000 for three months for certain deposits (home sale proceeds, insurance pay-outs, life events).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MIR statistics: Bulgarian bank rates on revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: 13.51% in September 2026 (13.49% in August), an average that includes overdrafts; no specific legal cap on card rates was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: SOFIX 1,838 on 29 Oct 2026 (base 100 in 2000), still below its October 2007 high of 1,982
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a small, illiquid market whose index has made no gain since 2007 despite a 72% rise in the past year.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 1-year term deposit 1.49% (tax-free, Sep 2026); SOFIX record since 2000
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of about 1.5% plus a 3.5-point premium, kept modest because SOFIX has a weak record since 2007; diversified euro-area funds give similar euro returns.

equity_return_high.sourceName: SOFIX long-run record (100 in 2000 to 1,838 in Oct 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run euro-area and global equity returns in euro terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected trend in the euro against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECB reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: savings 0.43%, term deposits up to 1 year 1.49% (interest tax-free, Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts and short deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: ECB MIR: term deposits up to 1 year 1.49%, 1-2 years 1.60%, over 2 years 2.86% (tax-free, Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of 1-year and longer term deposits, with no tax on EU bank interest.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding long government bonds, whose interest is tax-exempt.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Financial Supervision Commission publishes premiums and claims paid but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that we could find.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no published per-1,000 premium table by age was found; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost for one major private hospital stay was found; the National Health Insurance Fund pays for covered treatment with patient co-payments and extra fees at private hospitals.

health_premium_table.note: Voluntary health insurance in Bulgaria is sold as plan packages, and no age-banded premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket share 35.5% of current health expenditure. Latest World Bank year is 2023 (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat HICP health: 3.0% a year to Sep 2026
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical prices rose 3.0% in the year to September 2026; the 3% projection plus half a point is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat HICP education: 7.7% a year to Sep 2026, 12-month average 8.7%
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices have risen far faster than headline inflation, so 5% is used, between the projection and recent rates.

life_expectancy.note: Men 72.2, women 79.5; UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 76.1 for 2026. Latest World Bank year is 2024 (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for the year 2026 (asOf set to mid-year); totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 35.1 (2025, World Bank), 43.2 (2040) and 54.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/bulgaria/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Social Security Institute (NOI), pension for insurance length and age
retirement_age_default.note: Rises to 65 for both men and women (men in 2029, women in 2037), so 65 applies to anyone born after 1975; after 2037 it is to be linked to life expectancy. In 2026: men 64 years 9 months with 39 years 10 months of insurance, women 62 years 6 months with 36 years 10 months.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: National Social Security Institute (NOI), pension for insurance length and age
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants retire under the general pension age, 65 for both sexes for anyone born after 1975 (men 64 y 9 m, women 62 y 6 m in 2026); military, police and some other groups have lower ages.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: savings 0.43%, term deposits up to 1 year 1.49% (tax-free, Sep 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings accounts and short deposits.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just under the 1-year term deposit rate, which is untaxed.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of government bonds and long deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5% and half fixed income at about 2%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: National Social Security Institute (NOI), social old-age pension
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: EUR 183.81 a month from 1 July 2026 (EUR 170.51 from 1 January 2026).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: National Social Security Institute (NOI), social old-age pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: From age 70; the person's family income per member over the past year must be below 30% of the poverty line (EUR 390.63 a month in 2026), and the person may not receive any other pension.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service payment expressed in days of wages per year of service was found. The Labour Code is reported to give a lump-sum payment of gross monthly wages when employment ends after the right to a pension is acquired, which does not fit the days-per-year shape, and it could not be read from an official page (lex.bg returned 403).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Social Security Institute (NOI), pension conditions and calculation
public_pension_scheme.note: Pay-as-you-go state pension: average insured income x individual coefficient x 1.35% per year of insurance; pension age 65 for both sexes for anyone born after 1975 (64 y 9 m for men and 62 y 6 m for women in 2026). Minimum pension EUR 322.37 to 30 June 2026 and EUR 347.51 from 1 July 2026. Pensions are raised every 1 July under the Social Insurance Code (the cited page does not describe the indexation formula). Workers born after 1959 also pay into a universal pension fund (second pillar).

dps.note: No standard fixed-rate monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings bond sold to individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No regular 3-month treasury bill issuance was found.

tbond_5y.note: Sold at BNB auctions through primary dealers; individuals can buy through banks.

equity_fund.note: Local mutual funds and EU-listed index funds are available; capital gains on EU/EEA regulated markets are tax-exempt.

gold.note: Investment gold is VAT-exempt and freely bought.
